prompt:
Write 6 short claim log entries (one to three sentences each) by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim, in time order. Injury: back strain. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1080; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Photos confirm some details, but there are no independent witnesses.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- It is not fully clear where in the vehicle the claimant was sitting.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- Nothing suggests the damage happened before the coverage started.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text:
Entry 1: Claimant reported a sideswipe while changing lanes and said the other vehicle drifted into their lane at low speed. They described a back strain and said they were seen at a clinic the same day.

Entry 2: Photos submitted by the claimant show damage to the driver-side rear quarter panel, and the damage pattern appears consistent with the impact described. No independent witnesses have come forward so far.

Entry 3: Reviewed the policy record and confirmed the driver is named on it. Nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the start of coverage, and no earlier damage to the vehicle is known.

Entry 4: Claimant gave the same account of the collision in each conversation. Based on the description of the impact, the reported back strain is plausible, though it is not fully clear from the claimant's statements where in the vehicle they were sitting at the time.

Entry 5: Treatment records show a usual course of care, with visits tapering as the claimant's symptoms improved. No prior injury to the same body area is known from the claimant's history or available records.

Entry 6: File is ready for supervisor review. Photos confirm some details of the loss, the vehicle damage matches the described impact, and the claimant remains unrepresented by counsel.
